# CamelotWheel

The Camelot wheel as a selector and a map: 12 numbers around a clock face, outer ring B (major, lighter key colours), inner ring A (minor, darker), the playing…

`SongNodes.CamelotWheel` · Music

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.CamelotWheel selected={…} onSelectedChange={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.CamelotWheel" selected="{{…}}" on-selected-change="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (CamelotWheelProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nowKey` | `string` | Key playing now, standard Camelot ("8A" = A minor). |
| `selected` * | `string[]` | Selected keys (multi-select filter). |
| `onSelectedChange` * | `(keys: string[]) => void` | Selection change. |
| `counts` | `Record<string, number>` | Track counts per key; shown when `showCounts`. |
| `showCounts` | `boolean` | Show the count under each code. |
| `showCompatible` | `boolean` | Outline the clean mixes from `nowKey` (±1 same letter, relative key). Default true. |
| `size` | `number` | Rendered size in px (max 420). |
